facts.text: Round Hill is about a 20-minute transfer west from Montego Bay's airport.
facts.excerpt: It takes 20 minutes or so to transfer west from Montego Bay’s airport to Round Hill’s front gates

facts.text: Jamaican-born entrepreneur John Pringle opened Round Hill in 1953.
facts.excerpt: Jamaican-born entrepreneur John Pringle opened Round Hill in 1953

facts.text: John F. Kennedy stayed at Round Hill to write his inaugural speech.
facts.excerpt: John F. Kennedy even holed up here to write his inaugural speech.

facts.text: The Grill displays framed black-and-white photos of notable past guests, from Paul McCartney to Michael Douglas.
facts.excerpt: framed black-and-white photos of notable guests—from Paul McCartney with an infant Stella to Michael Douglas—hang on the walls

facts.text: Ralph Lauren, who owns a villa on the property, designed the Pineapple House rooms himself.
facts.excerpt: Lauren, who owns a villa on the property, designed them himself.

facts.text: Pineapple House rooms have clean white interiors with navy and pink accents.
facts.excerpt: the clean white interiors offset by crisp navy and pink accents

facts.text: Ocean View and Premium Ocean View rooms sit on the upper level with cathedral ceilings and large windows.
facts.excerpt: Ocean View and Premium Ocean View options sit on the upper level and boast cathedral ceilings and large windows

facts.text: Oceanfront Balcony and Premium Oceanfront Balcony rooms are on the lower level, each with a balcony.
facts.excerpt: On the lower level lie the Oceanfront Balcony and Premium Oceanfront Balcony rooms

facts.text: The villas are individually owned and range from two to six bedrooms.
facts.excerpt: are individually owned, and range from two to six bedrooms

facts.text: Villas offer shared living spaces, pools, kitchens and outdoor showers.
facts.excerpt: shared living spaces, pools, kitchens, outdoor showers

facts.text: The flagship restaurant, also designed by Ralph Lauren, serves fresh Caribbean food using ingredients from the onsite organic gardens.
facts.excerpt: Flagship restaurant at Round Hill (also designed by Ralph Lauren) serves up fresh Caribbean food that burns clean with ingredients from the onsite organic gardens.

facts.text: Dining options include the Seaside Terrace and private in-villa dining, including breakfast.
facts.excerpt: The Seaside Terrace and private in-villa dining (including breakfast)

facts.text: The spa is set in an 18th-century plantation house reached by a path that winds along the beach.
facts.excerpt: the path winds along the beach for nearly two kilometers before you reach the facility, a grand 18th-century plantation house flanked by a double stair

facts.text: In front of the spa is an adults-only soaking pool.
facts.excerpt: out front is a soaking pool that’s decidedly adults-only

facts.text: Spa treatments include massages, facials and scrubs.
facts.excerpt: Treatments are simple and effective—massages, facials, scrubs.

facts.text: The gym is at the spa and offers fitness and yoga classes.
facts.excerpt: The gym is also here, with fitness and yoga classes

facts.text: Day trips include the Appleton Estate rum distillery and YS Falls for ziplining and swimming.
facts.excerpt: Day trip options include excursions to rum distillery Appleton Estate and a visit to YS Falls for ziplining and swimming.

facts.text: Most of the staff at Round Hill have worked there for over three decades.
